findings.title: Ops RedactedLogger regex missed 77-char API key suffixes and whsec_/URI credentials
findings.rootCause: API_KEY_PREFIX_REGEX in ops/logging/redacted-logger.mjs bounded the suffix after cve_live_ to {16,64} characters with a trailing word boundary (\b). Real API keys issued by generateApiKeyMaterial() have a 77-character suffix (<12hex>_<64hex>), causing full API keys in free-form log strings to bypass regex redaction. Additionally, whsec_ webhook secrets, PEM private keys, and connection URI passwords lacked dedicated string patterns.
findings.remediation: Expanded API_KEY_PREFIX_REGEX to {12,128}, added WEBHOOK_SECRET_REGEX (whsec_), EXTERNAL_SECRET_REGEX (sk-, ghp_, AKIA), PRIVATE_KEY_BLOCK_REGEX, CONNECTION_URI_CREDENTIALS_REGEX, and expanded sensitive object key suffix matching in redactObject().

findings.title: Runbook 6 synthetic verification used static statusCode = 404 instead of live TenantRepository probe
findings.rootCause: SyntheticRunbookRunner.runRunbook6TenantIsolation() simulated the 404 anti-IDOR outcome with a static variable rather than invoking TenantRepository with an authenticated cross-tenant context.
findings.remediation: Updated runRunbook6TenantIsolation() to initialize an in-memory SQLite database with MigrationRunner, TenantConnectionPool, and TenantRepository, create a victim asset, execute a cross-tenant getAsset() probe, verify ResourceNotFoundError (404 NOT_FOUND), and persist attacker tenant suspension.
